scripts.verify: npm run verify:api && npm run verify:contract && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:api: cd services/backend && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run check && npm test
scripts.verify:web: cd apps/web && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.build:ios: cd apps/ios && xcodebuild -project Kimgosu.xcodeproj -scheme Kimgosu -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
